name: Operator: the developer
description: The developer: body and a separately modeled head grafted at the collar, his pack skinned to the Spine bone.

made_with.settings: multi-image, 4K texture; body (front, side, back), head (four views) and pack (three views) separately, then tools/prep_operator.py (graft, neck cleanup in clothes mode, remesh, bake, --rig); Meshy auto-rig; tools/add_fingers.py

notes: 57,400 faces: 45,400 body, head and hands, 12,000 pack, two textures. Mixamo-named finger bones with a relaxed curl as the rest pose (tools/add_fingers.py). The pack is part of the skinned mesh, weighted fully to Spine. In the battle as Charlie since 2026-10-17.
